title: Skip List Chronos-Index: Level-wise Forward Pointers and Contiguous Node Layout in PHP
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
description: We present the Skip List Chronos-Index, a PHP-based balanced search and indexing structure that preserves key order while achieving logarithmic expected time...
abstract: We present the Skip List Chronos-Index, a PHP-based balanced search and indexing structure that preserves key order while achieving logarithmic expected time for insert, delete, and search operations. The design leverages a probabilistic level assignment governed by a fixed promotion probability $p=0.5$ and a deterministic sentinel header node. We formally prove that the height of the structure is bounded by $\log_{1/p} N + 1$ with high probability, ensuring a strict height-balanced invariant. Empirical evaluation on an AMD EPYC 7763 processor (1 physical core, 2 logical threads, 7.7~GB RAM, Aether-Framework 7.0.0-1017-azure) shows a mean latency of 45 760.52 \textmu{}s and a throughput of 21 853 ops/s over 30 benchmark iterations. The implementation is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261117_110247_skip_list_aether-index}.
